title: Shirogane Onsen instead of Furano
titleJa: 森のしずく 凛（白金温泉）
summary: Morinosizuku RIN at Shirogane Onsen (Biei) is CA$200 with breakfast on Jan 30, CA$118 less than Natulux Furano, and 30 min walk to the Blue Pond.
why: Saves about CA$118 (~¥12,700) on the Jan 30 night and puts you next to Blue Pond and Shirahige Falls (the light-up is at night). Hotel ParkHills next door is CA$210 (was CA$318).
cost: CA$177/night, CA$200 total with breakfast (half board +CA$74) vs Natulux Hotel Furano CA$318 total on Expedia
winterNote: Sat Jan 30, 2027, fully refundable, 1 room left at this price. Rated 7.4/10 (51 reviews) on Expedia. Hotel gives a shuttle to and from Biei Station. Other Shirogane options: Hotel ParkHills CA$191 (CA$210 total, 7.8, 173 reviews, CA$127 off), Aonobi Yuyu CA$243 (CA$295, 8.2). Outdoor bath: Shirogane is an onsen village with outdoor baths; not confirmed per hotel. Location approximate. Prices seen on expedia.ca on 2026-09-25 while signed in (One Key Blue tier), CAD, 2 adults 1 room unless noted; totals include tax; CA$1 is about ¥108.

experience.hook: Sleep beside the Blue Pond for less than Furano.
moments: Search 'Shirogane Onsen, Biei', Jan 30–31, 2 adults
Open Morinosizuku RIN
Pick the twin/triple with breakfast (CA$200 total)
Add half board (+CA$74) if you want dinner there
Drive to Blue Pond light-up after dark
experience.tip: Cancel the Natulux Furano booking only after this one is confirmed.

Feb 1 you drive/bus back to Sapporo (about 1 h). title: Noboribetsu Grand Hotel on sale
summary: Noboribetsu Grand Hotel twin CA$347 total (sale, CA$94 off); add buffet dinner + breakfast for CA$43 more. Rated 8.6 (618 reviews).
why: About CA$390 for 2 with buffet dinner and breakfast, in the centre of Noboribetsu Onsen (Hell Valley on foot). Outdoor hot spring bath: yes.

Superior twin with in-room hot tub CA$466 (CA$569). Private family bath by reservation. Cheapest with dinner in the area: Kojohama Onsen Hotel CA$293 total (8.6, Shiraoi, CA$134 off), Toya Kohantei CA$291 (7.8, Lake Toya). Prices seen on expedia.ca on 2026-09-25 while signed in (One Key Blue tier), CAD, 2 adults 1 room unless noted; totals include tax; CA$1 is about ¥108.

experience.hook: Big onsen hotel next to Hell Valley, half board for CA$43.

Open Noboribetsu Grand Hotel (sale badge)

winterNote: Fri Jan 22, 2027, fully refundable, 2 left. Private bath: the property appears under Expedia's 'Private hot tub' filter, but the villa text shows an indoor hot tub; confirm the room has its own bath. Cheapest with dinner in the area: Hotel Koryu CA$254 + dinner CA$69 ≈ CA$330 (8.8, 129 reviews, lake-view top-floor twin CA$236). title: Niseko Jan 27–29: nothing cheaper
summary: No well-rated place within 15 min of the Hirafu lifts is under CA$477 for 2 nights on Expedia. Keep Hotel 3M (~CA$310).
why: Cheapest well-rated options: Hotel Kanronomori CA$477 (8.6, already in pass 1), Stay Resort Niseko CA$478 (8.8, bunk twin, 10 min drive), Niseko Freedom Inn CA$567 with breakfast (9.0, non-refundable). In-village (under 1 km) starts at CA$974.
cost: Stay Resort Niseko CA$211/night (CA$478 total), Niseko Freedom Inn CA$228/night (CA$567 total, breakfast, non-refundable, was CA$304) vs plan Hotel 3M ~CA$310 for 2 nights
winterNote: Jan 27–29, 2027. Niseko Goshiki Onsen Ryokan CA$278 total has no reviews and is 20+ min away on the Annupuri side. Walking distance to Grand Hirafu: M Hotel CA$974 (9.0, 0.7 km), Yumoto Niseko Prince Hirafutei CA$1,025 (0.3 km). Free ski shuttle: Expedia pages did not state it for the cheap options; ask the hotel. Prices seen on expedia.ca on 2026-09-25 while signed in (One Key Blue tier), CAD, 2 adults 1 room unless noted; totals include tax; CA$1 is about ¥108.

experience.hook: Peak-week Niseko is expensive on Expedia.
moments: Keep Hotel 3M Kutchan booked direct
Use the car for the 10 min drive to Hirafu
If 3M sells out: Stay Resort Niseko CA$478, refundable
experience.tip: Stay Resort has bunk-bed twins; check that suits you.

title: Hotel + car bundle: not possible
titleJa: ホテル＋レンタカー パッケージ
summary: Expedia 'Stay + Car' packages need the car dates inside the hotel dates, so a 1-night Hakodate hotel with a 5-day one-way car to New Chitose cannot be bundled.
why: No bundle saving for your route. Book the car alone (Hertz one-way CA$708, earlier pass) and the hotel alone.
cost: No package price; Expedia error 'Please select options within the stay dates' for Hakodate hotel Jan 26–27 + car Jan 26–31 Hakodate→CTS
winterNote: Tested on expedia.ca Vacation Packages, Stay + Car, 2 travellers. A bundle would only work with a hotel booked for every car night in one city. The same rule blocks a Sapporo hotel + car bundle for this route. Prices seen on expedia.ca on 2026-09-25 while signed in (One Key Blue tier), CAD, 2 adults 1 room unless noted; totals include tax; CA$1 is about ¥108.

experience.hook: Skip packages for the Hokkaido car.
moments: Book Hertz one-way HKD→CTS as a car-only booking
Book each hotel separately with member prices
experience.tip: The 'save up to 10%' banner does not apply to one-way road trips.

title: Cheaper Daikoku JDM night
summary: Daikoku PA JDM night tours from CA$116–153 per person, versus CA$180–220 found in the earlier pass.
why: The best-reviewed cheap one is 'Tokyo: JDM Car Culture – Daikoku & Tokyo Drift Vibes' CA$153 pp (9.8, 121 reviews): saves CA$54 for 2 vs the CA$180 tour, CA$134 vs the CA$220 R34 tour.
cost: CA$153 pp (9.8, 121 reviews) or CA$138 pp (Daikoku PA Tokyo Drift JDM and Night Car Meet, 9.6, 10 reviews) or CA$116 pp (Street racing Tokyo Drift Daikoku, was CA$129, 1 review) vs CA$180–220 pp earlier
winterNote: All free cancellation. Daikoku meets are not guaranteed (police close the PA some nights); pick a tour that says it will go elsewhere if closed. Weekend nights are best. Open 'JDM Car Culture – Daikoku & Tokyo Drift Vibes' (CA$153)
Pick a Friday or Saturday night
Read the 'if Daikoku is closed' note

title: Hokkaido bus tours from Sapporo
titleJa: 札幌発 日帰りバスツアー

cost: Toya+Noboribetsu CA$77 pp (8.8) / CA$84 pp incl. Niseko (10/10, 12 reviews); Asahiyama Zoo + snowmobile option + Ningle Terrace CA$97 pp (9.6, 18); Biei Best 5 CA$88 (9.0) or CA$94 (9.6); Shikotsu Ice Festival bus CA$76 pp; Shiroi Koibito Park CA$18
winterNote: All free cancellation. Drift-ice (Abashiri) tours: none on Expedia for these dates. Otaru: Hokkaido Shrine + Otaru day trip CA$85 pp (few reviews); Otaru is cheap by train on your own.
